title: GTA 6 first 48 hours checklist
intro: The best order to do things in your first two days, built from launch-day guides and checked against multiple sources. Tick things off as you go.

items.text: Leave automatic updates on so the day-one patches install
Run Brightness Calibration (nights are very dark) and turn on subtitles
If screenshots look washed out, check your HDR settings
Buy digitally by November 19 to get the Vintage Vice City Pack and a month of GTA+
Finish *Gone Fishing* to open up the world
Fix all 4 house projects (steps, roof, railing, bedroom wall) **before** *Coming Home*, or you'll miss them
Keep spare cash in the stash at Jason's safehouse until you can bank
Loot the Kingfishers: Fishing Shacks operation north-west of Key Lento (close to $2,000)
Finish Shirley's rum errand before you investigate the strange noises behind Three Sheets
Sell product to Brian or Donnie quickly, after comparing their prices
After *Clean Up After Donnie*, collect the four lost drug packages (about $900 each)
Open BuckMe in the *Buck Me* mission and deposit everything
Reach the first $5,000 savings goal
Loot the crashed plane in the field south of Hamlet
Start Kenton's treasure dives after *Island Dreams*
After *Just a Scratch*, remember you can call Joey to bring your car
Sell trackerless cars to Moses ($1,000 to $3,000 each)
Unlock free switching between Jason and Lucia (hold D-pad Right, press R1 / RB)
Use RydeMe to fast travel ($100 to skip the ride)
Register a stolen car as your personal vehicle
Train Focus at Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range
Rob jewelry stores for Yasmani ($10,000 to $25,000 each)
Get the Key Cloner and fill Randy's wish list ($30,000+ per car)
Hit small banks and payday loans after *Credit Check*
Rob bank vaults after *That's Where The Money Is…* (up to $205,000)
